attacks.targeted_failure_mode: The generic SAT-to-independent-set reduction has no theta gap on moderately dense random 3CNF.
attacks.method: Apply the Feige-Ofek result to the unmodified generic reduction and compare the returned theta value with the clause target.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: The compiler may first solve SAT and then emit a graph with a planted gap.
attacks.method: Require a fixed local or otherwise independently bounded compiler whose correctness can be verified without evaluating SAT.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: An inverse-polynomial real SDP gap may lack polynomial-bit rational certificates.
attacks.method: Charge all coefficient bits and require primal/dual residual bounds sufficient for exact Boolean classification.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Existing SDP extension-complexity lower bounds might already imply the claimed obstruction.
attacks.method: Compare the finite local lift model with explicit stable-set SDP lower bounds and identify the missing preservation theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Polynomially many extension variables can collapse theta rank even when the original formulation is hard.
attacks.method: Search for extended formulations whose projection is hard but whose lifted ideal has low theta rank.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: The phrase finite local grammar may still permit global computation through repeated local rules.
attacks.method: Require fixed templates, canonical scheduling, polynomial explicit trace, and no semantic oracle.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Theta rank may collapse under invertible affine substitutions or elimination.
attacks.method: Audit rank behavior separately under variable renaming, invertible GF(2) substitution, Gaussian elimination, and local cardinality definitions.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: A pure parity family is trivially removed and cannot witness the conjecture.
attacks.method: Reject pure Tseitin/XOR candidates and require a non-affine residual after all affine consequences are exhausted.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Random residual expansion is not an explicit polynomial-time family.
attacks.method: Require deterministic construction or a derandomized generator with a proved preservation theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Geometric equivalence may hide exponential coefficient bits.
attacks.method: Track rational encoding length through Gram/moment matrices, duality, and proof lines.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Weak feasibility or lack of Slater conditions may break certificate extraction.
attacks.method: Separate exact infeasibility certificates from numerical solver output and require symbolic residual checks.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: The chosen theta hierarchy and proof syntax may not be polynomially equivalent under repository size measures.
attacks.method: Demand explicit translations in both directions for level one before extrapolating to arbitrary k.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: No opposite-label formulas may share the full registered theta profile even at small size.
attacks.method: Enumerate bounded CNFs, build conflict graphs, and compare exact low-level moment statistics before attempting asymptotics.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: The profile may include enough information to reconstruct the entire instance, making equality impossible but scientifically empty.
attacks.method: Restrict the exposed statistics to fixed-level, polynomial-size, isomorphism-invariant data.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: A fixed local grammar may simulate arbitrary computation over polynomially many steps.
attacks.method: Charge the full trace and require the twin family to fool only precisely enumerated grammars, not an undefined class.
